title.zh: 将西达沃省马利塔市描笼涯达图丹瓦塔的达图丹瓦塔小学——巴利斯分校（TFS of Balis）从达图丹瓦塔小学分离，改制为独立小学，定名为巴利斯小学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Datu Danwata Elementary School-TFS of Balis Extension in Barangay Datu Danwata, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental From the Datu Danwata Elementary School, Converting It Into An Independent Elementary School to Be Known as the Balis Elementary School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Trường Tiểu học Datu Danwata – Cơ sở Mở rộng TFS of Balis tại Barangay Datu Danwata, Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Malita, Tỉnh Davao Occidental ra khỏi Trường Tiểu học Datu Danwata và chuyển đổi thành Trường Tiểu học Độc lập mang tên Trường Tiểu học Balis
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกโรงเรียนประถมศึกษานายดาตูดันวาตา–สาขาบาลิส (TFS of Balis) ในบารังไกย์ดาตูดันวาตา อำเภอมาลิตา จังหวัดดาเวาโอซิเดนทัล ออกจากโรงเรียนประถมศึกษานายดาตูดันวาตา และเปลี่ยนเป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาอิสระชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาบาลิส
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Datu Danwata Elementary School – TFS of Balis Extension di Barangay Datu Danwata, Kota Malita, Provinsi Davao Occidental dari Datu Danwata Elementary School dan Mengubahnya Menjadi Sekolah Dasar Mandiri yang Dikenal sebagai Balis Elementary School
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Datu Danwata Elementary School – TFS of Balis Extension di Barangay Datu Danwata, Bandar Malita, Wilayah Davao Occidental daripada Datu Danwata Elementary School dan Menukarnya kepada Sekolah Rendah Bebas yang Dikenali sebagai Balis Elementary School

text.en: The Datu Danwata Elementary School - TFS of Balis Extension in Barangay Datu Danwata, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental is hereby separated from the Datu Danwata Elementary School to be known as the Balis Elementary School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Datu Danwata Elementary School - TFS of Balis Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Balis Elementary School

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Balis Elementary School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Daut Danwata Elementary School - TFS of Balis Extension. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall promulgate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
